title: Knowledge + operations / supporting routes
subtitle: These entries have bounded outputs: decisions, reports, board transitions, repair or runtime posture. They do not implicitly enter implementation.

nodes.title: /adr · /adr-status
nodes.body:
Author or read-only status
Select mode before prerequisites

nodes.title: decision-lifecycle
nodes.body:
Author: actual user choice + attribution
Status: age, challenges, supersession
CONFIRM questions are never guessed

nodes.title: ADR / health report
nodes.body:
Numbered, dated decision record
Or read-only lifecycle report
Accepted/Planned ≠ implementation

nodes.title: Future scope-relevant context
nodes.body:
Recorded intent constrains spec authoring
Affected ADRs return through indexes
No automatic product change

nodes.title: /reconcile
nodes.body:
Drift / architectural variance
Report-only or explicit reconciliation

nodes.title: decision-variance
nodes.body:
Scoped scout evidence → SMARTS grader
Optional decision-challenger
Grader recommends; user chooses

nodes.title: Report / attributed ruling
nodes.body:
Read-only mode writes nothing
Chosen reconciliation enters decision-log
Separate ADR owner when required

nodes.title: /conflict / internal STOP
nodes.body:
Contradictory governing rules
Stop other work; surface both sides
Resolve authority before resuming

nodes.title: /status
nodes.body:
Default: read-only state
drift: provenance audit
Alias: /context-check

nodes.title: context-check / selected refresh
nodes.body:
Report v1 and v2 states separately
Select affected docs or explicit full refresh
Qualified scouts + native v2 pair writes

nodes.title: Status / drift report
nodes.body:
Read-only report, or selected native update
Keep marker, unselected files and history
No staging, commit or reinitialization

nodes.title: /doctor
nodes.body:
Install, payload, package ownership
Enforcement config + harmless probe
Output: diagnostic / capability gap

nodes.title: /task
nodes.body:
Authorized add / start / done
Terminal harvest or concrete follow-up
Debug outcome alone writes nothing

nodes.title: taskwrite.py → _taskboardlib
nodes.body:
Only sanctioned board writer
start stamps date; done needs in-progress
Never delete an entry to mark it done

nodes.title: Task-board transition
nodes.body:
open-tasks.md work state
Not a typed-plan acceptance receipt
Later work still selects its own lane

nodes.title: /standup
nodes.body:
Inspect hygiene, branches and worktrees
Confirm each safe cleanup
Never silently lose dirty / unpushed work

nodes.title: /audit → dated governance packet
nodes.body:
Read source records for a selected window. Preserve audit lines.
Write a new packet only; never overwrite the source or an older packet.

nodes.title: /metrics → trends against prior window
nodes.body:
Overrides, small-lane classifications and low-confidence sprint choices.
Read-only measurement, not an automatic policy change.

nodes.title: /override → attributed exception
nodes.body:
Only where the governing hard rule permits; explicit reason and consent.
Append to overrides.log. Not a universal security or authority bypass.

nodes.title: mode --arbiter / --ops / --dangerous
nodes.body:
Deterministic control tokens, not slash entries.
Safety-core remains composed with the active mode body.
Ops is advisory runtime work; tracked/history changes route normally.

nodes.title: /prune → host-specific context control
nodes.body:
Claude: dry-run by default, never execute against the live transcript.
Pi: native compaction, not active-session rewriting.
No Codex transcript route is asserted.

nodes.title: /statusline → Claude configuration
nodes.body:
Install / uninstall / inspect the owned statusline.
This catalog surface is Claude-specific.
It does not establish cross-host runtime parity.

nodes.title: /commands · /btw
nodes.body: Grouped catalog / deprecated lightweight Q&A. Direct questions need no slash command.

nodes.title: /decompose · /create-context
nodes.body: Initial population only: /init --greenfield / --brownfield. Initialized refresh stays with /status drift and explicit selection.

nodes.title: /watch · /cleanup · /context-check
nodes.body: Prefer /pr --watch / --cleanup and /status drift. These modes branch before unrelated creation-time preflights.

panels.title: 01  /  USER-OWNED INTENT AND CONTRADICTION HANDLING
panels.caption: Separate a recommendation from a decision, and an accepted decision from delivery evidence.

panels.title: 02  /  READ STATE, REPAIR KNOWLEDGE, MANAGE WORK
panels.caption: Each writing action uses its sanctioned owner. Read-only entry modes remain read-only.

panels.title: 03  /  GOVERNANCE RECORDS AND OBSERVABILITY
panels.caption: Source records remain authoritative; a summary neither changes them nor approves a workflow.

panels.title: 04  /  HOST POSTURE AND CONTEXT HYGIENE
panels.caption: These controls must not be drawn as an unrestricted alternate route around the normal pipeline.

panels.title: 05  /  HELP AND RETAINED ENTRY SPELLINGS
panels.caption: Aliases preserve the existing owner’s procedure and gates; they are not alternate semantics.

notes.text: All 37 commands are selectable in the HTML. For auxiliary routes, the atlas records catalog-level owner contracts rather than claiming a line-by-line implementation audit.
